reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Nets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 66 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Memphis come in confident after a 142-111 rout of New Orleans on Friday, which avenged an overtime loss earlier this month. They are on a back-to-back, Zach Edey is not yet cleared to play both nights, and the FAA ground stop affected travel for both teams on Friday night. Brooklyn are better rested, but no coaching, trade or locker-room story has surfaced for either side. The mental angle is close to neutral, with a slight edge to Brooklyn on freshness.
